acceptance_criteria.statement: All 193 local Jira work items compile to strict task-state records and the project compiles from REGISTERED through COMPILING to READY.
Invalid transitions and stale expected versions fail before state changes, while accepted transitions create immutable history with actor and correlation identity.

definition_of_done: Implementation and configuration for the bounded objective are complete.
Acceptance criteria have current automated or machine-readable evidence.
Required behavior tests pass for the affected state or traceability capability.
Traceability, plans, Jira, schemas, documentation, and evidence are current.
Security, authority, observability, migration, and rollback effects are explicit.
Unavailable live PostgreSQL or external verification is represented without inflating completion.
description: Implement project and task lifecycle enums, transition tables, blocked-state invariants, version checks, typed transition records, actor/correlation provenance, and complete local Jira work-item compilation.
exclusions: No remote GitHub, Jira, AWS, PostgreSQL, package-index, or paid-service mutation is authorized.
No complete Project Control Kernel, durable orchestration runtime, scheduler, or Command Center capability is represented as complete.
objective: Provide explicit admissible state transitions, optimistic concurrency, immutable history, and Jira task-state compilation.
observability_impact: Persist actor, correlation, revision, transition, migration, import, and evidence identities for later operational telemetry.
rationale: This bounded core-state implementation converts validated planning and registries into typed, transactional, queryable behavior while preserving explicit authority and live-verification boundaries.
rollback_recovery_consideration: Restore the prior cumulative archive, remove local runtime state, reapply the committed migration catalog, and reimport authoritative registries; no external state requires rollback.
scope: Provide explicit admissible state transitions, optimistic concurrency, immutable history, and Jira task-state compilation.
security_impact: Preserve strict validation, least privilege, source authority, secret-reference handling, optimistic concurrency, and fail-closed mutation boundaries.
title: Implement versioned project and task lifecycle state
